node: Vertically integrated dough, food ingredient, and restaurant supply-chain infrastructure
summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expands the public-company universe around restaurant supply-chain infrastructure rather than restaurant traffic alone. The strongest reference case is Domino's, whose franchise model is paired with owned dough manufacturing and food distribution. The underfollowed lane points to B2B suppliers that sit outside the restaurant sector classification but may provide coffee, ingredients, private-label manufacturing, direct-store delivery, or foodservice supply-chain services to restaurants and franchise systems. Evidence strength is uneven: Domino's has direct evidence from provided research snippets; Westrock and Farmer Brothers have plausible foodservice/restaurant supply-chain exposure; TreeHouse Foods is included as a second-order private-label/manufacturing candidate because of its acquisition of Farmer Brothers' non-DSD business, but requires verification of restaurant-channel contribution. Layer 1B expands the universe around restaurant commissary, dough/ingredient distribution, beverage supply, and direct-store-delivery infrastructure. The reference lane is anchored by pizza franchisors that disclose captive supply-chain or QC-center economics, especially DPZ and PZZA. The underfollowed lane points to B2B coffee/beverage and foodservice supply-chain providers that are classified outside restaurants but may benefit when chains and independent operators outsource procurement, roasting, beverage formulation, DSD, equipment service, and ingredient consistency.
